conditions.name: IsAlive
conditions.scope: Null initialized record returns0; definition pointer at+4 is otherwise read unchecked, then group pointer definition+0x144. No group: record live bit0x1000 and dead byte+0x28b==0, without active-bit1 requirement. Group present: first nonnull member with active/live mask0x1001 and dead byte0 succeeds, using group uint8 count+7 and pointer slots+0xc. Zero-count group returns0 regardless of solo record flags. Does not update lifetime or groups.

conditions.scope: Loads uint8 script packet+0xb0 without null guard and returns float0..255. This is packet set ID, not actor membership byte+0x378.

namedInitializerContract: 0x440f10 and0x441690 require operand and global name callback0x923904; both allow null system, return reference record without dereferencing first-pointer physical object. Null/failed names initialize0. Alias resolution and lifetimes are callback adapters.

adapters.scope: ASCII names map to reference records or null; callback retains null-system calls. References that share physical-object first pointer remain distinct.

limits: No game execution,reference lifetime,group construction,spline updates or population of aggregate globals.
IsAlive reads initialized record+4 definition without guard; missing definition faults native and portable source throws explicitly.
Solo IsAlive tests live bit1000 without active bit1; grouped members need both. An existing zero-count group overrides solo liveness.
MySet has no packet-null guard; actual faults saved,portable source throws explicitly.
Prepared group member arrays honor uint8 count through255; generic malformed/out-of-backing memory is outside scope.
Actor array uses original stride0x10d8; counted records and liveness fields must be prepared.
Global NumBaddiesThatCanSeePlayers is signed dword read; tests compare float32 storage boundary used by SCP evaluator.
ASCII names only in portable source; alias policy and callback side effects beyond fixture resolution external.
Managed execution pending under existing EPERM restriction; no launch retry.

assemblyFindings.detail: Named initializer checks only operand/callback; system parameter is passed to callback even when0. Unlike UnderPlayerControl and OnSpeederBike named initializers, it does not require a nonnull system.
Reads initialized record definition+4 before any pointer-null guard; group and solo paths intentionally use different live/active-bit gates.
Packet+0xb0 is loaded with uint8 zero extension; no packet-null guard or actor fallback.
Original fild dword[0x876840] establishes signed integer storage despite Ghidra ambiguous global type.
One authored threshold uses1.0f. Retained scalar comparison uses recovered native decimal-prefix parser semantics; source text/loader reachability remains external.
